name: Airport Facilities Co., Ltd.
summary: Airport Facilities Co., Ltd. engages in the airport related businesses in Japan and internationally. The company engages in purchase, sale, management, brokerage, leasing, and appraisal of real estate; area heating and cooling; water supply and drainage management and treatment; shared telecommunications-related business; and other operating, managing, and leasing airport-related facilities. It also offers research, design, and supervision of construction work.
